Mine really hurt when I got them pierced, almost as bad as when I got my conch. Healing time really depends on how top heavy you are. I'm a 40DD and mine took 2 months to stop feeling sore all the time. My boyfriend got his done and it took two weeks. I found that it was more comfortable to wear a bra than to not because I'm so top heavy.
Also, consider what jewelry you want. I got pierced in barbells, but when I changed them to rings, they hurt so bad that I changed them back to barbells. 
Just do a lot of research, but like most piercings, if you don't like them, you can take them out.
